items.originalTitle: The new iPad Mini is getting its first major discount for Black Friday
items.author: Sheena Vasani
items.title: The new iPad Mini is getting its first major discount for Black Friday
items.summary: I’m not saying you should read on an iPad next to fountain. I’m just saying you can. | Photo: David Pierce / The Verge We were big fans of Apple’s new iPad Mini when we reviewed it in early November, but its steep starting price of $699 was hard to swallow. Thankfully, the small tablet is already getting a sizable discount for Black Friday. Right now, Amazon and Walmart are both selling the 2026 iPad Mini with Wi-Fi and 128GB of storage starting at $599 ($100 off), its lowest price to date. iPad Mini (2026) Where to Buy: $699 $599 at Amazon (Wi-Fi, 128GB) $699 $599 at Walmart (Wi-Fi, 128GB) $799 $749 at Amazon (Wi-Fi, 256GB) The new Mini is a notable upgrade over its predecessor, with a larger 8.5-inch OLED display that delivers deeper blacks and better contrast than the previous model’s 8.3-inch LCD. Despite the bigger screen, the tablet itself is smaller and lighter, making it easier to carry. Apple also added IP67 dust and water resistance, so you have less reason to worry about where you use it. As my colleague David Pierce noted in his review, that made a big difference in his day-to-day use; he felt more comfortable handing the Mini to his spill-prone toddler or keeping it nearby in the kitchen to follow recipes. He even took it into the shower to keep watching a football game. The upgraded A20 Pro chip also made apps load faster and demanding games run better in Pierce’s testing, while battery life held steady at around nine hours of screentime. At $599, though, the new Mini is still relatively expensive if you mainly want a tablet for browsing the web or streaming shows. The last-gen iPad Mini, which runs on Apple’s A17 Pro chip, is available for under $500 if you’d rather save another $100 and can live without the OLED screen and water resistance. But if you’ve been waiting for a more worthwhile upgrade to Apple’s smallest tablet, the current Black Friday discount makes the new model easier to justify. iPad Mini (2024) Where to Buy: $599 $484 at Amazon (128GB, Wi-Fi) $699 $584 at Amazon (256GB, Wi-Fi) $899 $784 at Amazon (512GB, Wi-Fi) Read our full iPad Mini review .

items.originalTitle: Denisovan remains and an unknown archaic human lineage discovered in southern China
items.title: Denisovan remains and an unknown archaic human lineage discovered in southern China
items.summary: An international team of researchers, including first author Song Xing, a researcher affiliated with the Centro Nacional de Investigación sobre la Evolución Humana (CENIEH), has just published a study in the journal Nature that analyzed four fossil teeth recovered from two caves in southern China. The team has identified two possible human lineages dating to the Middle and Late Pleistocene: one with Denisovan affinities and another more primitive lineage whose evolutionary identity remains unclear.

items.originalTitle: European oil and gas firms likely downplayed energy crisis profits, study finds
items.title: European oil and gas firms likely downplayed energy crisis profits, study finds
items.summary: Following the Russian attack on Ukraine in February 2022, energy costs rose sharply and many households and businesses felt the financial burden immediately. Oil and gas companies, however, were making extraordinary profits during this time. As public criticism of high energy costs grew, how did these companies handle their profits? A new study shows that European oil and gas firms likely downplayed their profits between 2022 and 2023. These earnings management practices were particularly prevalent in countries that introduced windfall profit taxes as well as in countries with strong democratic institutions.
